body:
Thank you for the offer — I’m open to such a PR.

IMHO, the best entrypoint to wire RunLedger to is the core chat agent used everywhere else: `src/agentic_ai/graph.py` via `run_chat` (this is what `src/agentic_ai/app.py` and `src/agentic_ai/cli.py` ultimately call). I’d suggest a tiny adapter script under `evals/runledger/` that calls run_chat directly so you don’t need to boot FastAPI. The tool surface is registered in `src/agentic_ai/layers/tools.py` if you need to map/allowlist tools in the suite.

If you prefer the “bonus” coding pipeline instead, the CLI entrypoint is `Agentic-Coding-Pipeline/run.py`, but it’s heavier and touches external services, so it’s a less stable target for a minimal deterministic demo.

Thanks - I followed your suggestion and wired RunLedger to the core chat flow (src/agentic_ai/graph.py via run_chat), so it doesn't need to boot FastAPI.

PR: https://github.com/hoangsonww/Agentic-AI-Pipeline/pull/24

It adds a deterministic CI regression check (record once, replay in CI) under evals/runledger, using recorded tool outputs so the run stays consistent without network calls or API keys.

Local run:
runledger run evals/runledger --mode replay --baseline baselines/runledger-demo.json
